description:
Rescope of the original "streaming SSE support" task.

The v0.1 Anthropic client (src/provider/anthropic.rs — blocking, non-streaming) lives inside the root `lernie` crate, which violates PRINCIPLES "Integrations are external binaries": the binary transitively pulls in the whole harness. Streaming is also missing; UI (ARCH §7, v0.5) needs token-by-token output and the adapter-contract §4.4 already specifies normalized streaming events.

This epic covers the full extraction + streaming story. Children:

1. Extract lernie-provider-anthropic to a workspace crate (drop crate::config coupling; binary compiles independently).
2. Harness adapter-wire types in src/provider/wire.rs; src/prompt stops importing from the provider crate so out-of-tree adapters don't need lernie as a dep.
3. Anthropic client streaming: Client::send_streaming, Event enum, accumulate helper, Error::Sse.
4. Adapter streaming wire: run_complete gains stream: true; emits normalized §4.4 events (message_start, content_block_start, text_delta, tool_use_delta, content_block_stop, message_stop); SIGTERM → final event within 5s; describe.capabilities += "streaming".

=== Terminal gates === Existing bl-4033 (tests), bl-403c (docs), bl-48dd (alignment). Rescoped to cover the full extraction + streaming story, not just the raw client.

=== Out of scope === Prompt caching (separate ball). Tool-use streaming event content (v0.3 when tool use lands; shape reserved). UI consumption of the stream (v0.5). File-path-as-stdin adapter input (separate standalone ball — nice-to-have, not required for streaming).
title: Anthropic integration: extract to standalone crate + streaming end-to-end
